title: Before the Tree of Life
subtitle: Kabbalah did not arrive as one secret doctrine from antiquity. It emerged from centuries of visions, texts, arguments, rituals, diagrams, and reinventions—and the changes are part of the evidence.
description: The familiar Tree of Life compresses two thousand years of Jewish mystical history. Tracing throne visions, Hekhalot texts, Sefer Yetzirah, medieval Kabbalah, the Zohar, Safed, Hasidism, Christian Cabala, and Hermetic Qabalah restores the chronology.
author: EmberFire Research
methodology: This publication expands the approved EFR-JMYST-001 canonical article through a September 19, 2026 source review. It distinguishes literary attribution from critical dating, ancient foundations from medieval Kabbalah, Jewish Kabbalah from Christian Cabala and Hermetic Qabalah, and textual continuity from later diagrammatic standardization. Where a branch requires manuscript- or school-specific treatment, it is preserved as an explicit follow-up investigation rather than compressed into a false universal history.
